definitions.gloss: minor power; weak nation; small and weak country
definitions.explanation: A country with little military, economic, or political strength, easily swayed by larger powers. Contrasted with great powers.

examples.japanese: {弱小国|じゃくしょうこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大国|たいこく}→大国：12218_taikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Minor powers are easily influenced by great powers.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弱小国|じゃくしょうこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済大国|けいざいたいこく}→経済大国：27186_keizaitaikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A former minor power grew into an economic powerhouse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{弱小国|じゃくしょうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}き→届く：00899_todoku⟧にくいこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the international community, the voices of minor powers can be hard to get heard.

notes:
A nation lacking power on the world stage. The element {弱小|じゃくしょう} (weak and small) also appears in everyday words like {弱小|じゃくしょう}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧ (a weak team).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弱小国|じゃくしょうこく}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: being treated as a minor power
- {弱小国|じゃくしょうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: the position of a minor power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大国|たいこく}→大国：12218_taikoku⟧: great power — a major, influential nation, the opposite
- ⟦{強国|きょうこく}→強国：15224_kyoukoku⟧: strong nation — emphasizes military or economic strength
